title: Staging gateway canonical Platform Admin workspace resolution

phases.objective: Resolve the Staging platform_admin service principal through the canonical Platform Admin Workspace markers instead of the non-schema workspace_type='platform_admin' sentinel, and fail closed on ambiguous canonical matches without provider access or mutation.

e2e_journeys.actor: Server-governed Staging Activation Gateway dry-run authority
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The service principal resolves exactly one ready canonical Platform Admin Workspace from Runtime DB markers, rejects ambiguity, preserves Governance-owned resource binding resolution, and performs no provider or Production mutation.
steps: Resolve the authenticated backend service principal as service/platform_admin.
Read workspace_registry only from the Runtime DB.
Match the canonical Platform Admin Workspace using workspace_key or config_json authority markers.
Reject more than one ready canonical Platform Admin Workspace instead of selecting an arbitrary row.
Continue resolving the exact Staging Worker resource binding only from the Governance DB.
Keep feature-gate and server credential checks independent and fail closed before provider execution.
assertions: workspace_type='platform_admin' is not used as Platform Admin authority evidence.
A schema-valid workspace_type with canonical platform markers resolves successfully.
Ambiguous canonical Platform Admin Workspace matches fail closed.
Feature gate false keeps apply_ready=false after successful workspace resolution.
No Cloudflare provider call, provider mutation, database mutation, or Production mutation is introduced.
